---
title: Safe Retries Before Release Publication
---

## Overview

An unpublished release workflow can be retried after a failed validation, package build, or draft preparation. Retries reuse the version tag only when it points to the original commit, and they stop if the release has already been published.

## Highlights

Release artifacts are selected from the jobs that produced them, so retrying only failed jobs can use successful artifacts from an earlier attempt. An existing draft is refreshed only when its title, notes, and asset names match the validated release content.
